## Batched prefix lookup and streaming fetch

This release makes large prefix-query lists substantially faster and starts
writing records before every query has been resolved (streaming), unless when using `--sort-by-offset`

On a 67 GB BGZF FASTA with a 361 MB `.ffx` index, fetching 10,000 unsorted
prefix queries improved from 15.52 seconds to 2.41 seconds. With
`--sort-by-offset`, the same query set improved from 16.44 seconds to 2.09
seconds

Example for request-order streaming:

```bash
fastars fetch \
  --fasta sequences.fna.bgz \
  --ids-file ids.txt \
  --id-mode prefix \
  --fetch-threads 16 > selected.fna
```

For maximum throughput when output order does not matter, add
`--sort-by-offset`. This delays the first output until all matches have been
resolved and sorted.
